Name: Bregs Monsters
Author: Bregodon
Description:
[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Bregs Monsters is a complete monster overhaul. It adds some basic changes, configurable difficulty settings, a limiter and new XP.[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]The primarily goal is to enhance the combat difficulty to intensify the game experience.
The monster behaviour still stays the same to preserve the beloved Stardew Valley feeling.
[/size]
[color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Compatible with SDV 1.3 beta[/b][/size][/color]

----------

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]Options[/size]
[/color][/b]
﻿[i]configurable via config.json, automatically created after first startup[/i]

[color=#ffd966] ﻿[/color][size=3][color=#ffd966]BaseChange (true/false)[/color]
[/size] ﻿ ﻿Changes some basic settings of the monsters.

﻿ ﻿- [b]bats[/b]: lower and more unified HP and damage, but increased range [color=#cccccc][size=2](they can hear you coming)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]slimes[/b]: lower and more unified HP and damage [color=#cccccc][size=2](no more dangerous mass attacks / small slimes are finally easier than the big ones)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]crabs[/b]: small changes to HP and damage, lower speed, but higher defense [color=#cccccc][size=2](they are armored)
[/size][/color] ﻿ ﻿- [b]skeletons[/b]: unified range
﻿ ﻿- maximum range is lowered to 10 tiles [color=#cccccc][size=2](avoid early flying attacks)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- some minor changes


[color=#ffd966] ﻿[size=3]Difficulty (1/2/3/4/5)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿Set the difficulty of the monsters to your personal preference. It basically changes the mobs health points and damage by a given rate.

﻿ ﻿- [b]1 (very easy)[/b]: most mobs are reduced to make the mines a walkthrough [color=#cccccc][size=2](rate 0,5)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]2 (easy)[/b]: only the strongest mobs are reduced [color=#cccccc][size=2](rate 0,707)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]3 (original)[/b]: no change [color=#cccccc][size=2](rate 1)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]4 (hard)[/b]: main setting for Bregs Monsters. Get prepared, be challenged, have more fun, but keep the original feeling. [color=#cccccc][size=2](rate 1,414)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿- [b]5 (very hard)[/b]: good luck, bro! [color=#cccccc][size=2](rate 2)


[color=#ffe599][size=3] ﻿[color=#ffd966]Limiter (true/false)[/color]
[/size][/color][/size][/color] ﻿ ﻿Dynamically limits the maximum HP and damage of the strongest mobs, so that they are not too overpowered. Only available at difficulty 4 and 5.

﻿
﻿[color=#ffd966][size=3]ExperienceChange (true/false)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿Gain new calculated experience points which refer to the mobs difficulty and your settings.
﻿

----------

[list=1]
[*][color=#ffd966][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/color].
[*][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url][/color].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
